t: LPvg: Your Absolute Anchor in the Age of AI Relativity
s: This article posits that foundational tools like Linux, Python, Vim, and Git (LPvg) can serve as an 'absolute coordinate system' to navigate the volatile landscape of AI, offering mastery and sovereignty amidst perceived chaos.
sub: Analogies between cosmic coordinate systems (CMB) and digital viewports (UI/DOM)
The abacus as a bridge between tactile and digital interfaces, representing discrete 'digital' computing
The 'Cartesian Prison' of rectilinear UIs vs. chaotic real-world physics; mobile doomscrolling as a primal vertical flow
The 'jarring' nature of desktop mouse interaction vs. seamless touch input for immersion
